subject: [PATCH 32/60] cgroup/cpuset: keep spread page cache off private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch author posted an initial patch with a brief explanation of the problem and solution. The code change is relatively simple, adding a loop to avoid private nodes when spreading page cache.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues related to memory allocation and cgroup/cpuset interactions in the Linux kernel. Specifically, it modifies the cpuset_spread_node function to avoid spreading page cache over private nodes, which can lead to inefficient memory usage.
